column2: The colonial powers of Europe gathered in $CAPITAL$ to discuss the regulation of colonization and trade in Africa, formalizing the scramble for the African continent. Relevant to us, the colonial powers have pledged to stamp out slavery and the slave trade, including within the lands of our principal suppliers. Unless we or some other power act, the Atlantic Slave Trade is finished.
The End of the Slave Trade Forced upon Us!

The colonial powers have conquered all of Africa south of the Sahara. This includes every one of our trading partners and the supply of slaves is dried up, the Atlantic Slave Trade is over.  Given our status as the leaders of the trade, our failure to act or at least end the trade on our own terms has lost us a tremendous amount of prestige.
